observations: Photo 0 shows a single black plastic automotive part (appears to be an under-body/engine splash shield or wheel-well liner), lying on a wooden pallet outdoors.
A watermark text 'HONDA AND ACURA' is visible on the part.
No engine, suspension component, VIN plate, or part number is visible in the photo.
No other photos were provided to show the width of the seller's claimed inventory (engines, suspension, other body parts).

claims.claim: Engine, suspension and body parts for all models of Acura and Honda cars and SUVs
claims.evidence: Only one photo of a single plastic trim part is shown; no engine or suspension part is pictured.
No shipping documents, container photos, or import paperwork shown.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened
claims.evidence: These claims describe an engine, but the photo shows a plastic body/under-panel part, not an engine; no engine photo or test clip provided.

risks.risk: Exact fitment (which Honda/Acura model/year this part fits) is unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the part number sticker/stamp or a side-by-side with a VIN-matched part list.
risks.if_unproven: price as generic unverified-fit used part, lowest tier

risks.risk: Claims about engine condition ('no knock', 'low mileage', 'tested') are applied generically but the photo shown is not an engine at all.
risks.proof: Photo or video of the actual engine running, with mileage/odometer or ECU readout visible.

risks.risk: Origin claim ('Tokunbo from Belgium') cannot be confirmed, affecting trust in condition and authenticity.
risks.proof: Bill of lading, import clearance papers, or container unloading video.
risks.if_unproven: treat origin as unverified, no premium for 'direct import' claim

risks.risk: Seller advertises a huge range of parts ('all models') with only one photo, which may indicate a stock photo/catalog listing rather than the actual item for sale.
risks.proof: Photos of the specific part(s) the buyer intends to purchase, taken by the seller at the current location.
risks.if_unproven: treat listing as generic/unverified stock rather than a specific confirmed item

proof_requests: Photo of the engine (if engine is the item of interest) showing it running or at least intact with visible part/serial numbers.
Close-up of any part number or VIN-matching sticker on the pictured body part.
Import/clearance documents or video of the shipment arriving from Belgium.
Additional photos of the actual engine, suspension, or other body parts mentioned in the text, not just the one trim piece shown.
response.reason: The single photo shows only a generic plastic body/under-panel part with no model-specific markings, and no comparable listings exist for this kind of item to anchor a price; the seller's broad engine/suspension claims are unverifiable and unrelated to the one photo provided.
